The pathfinder confirms: "no walkable tile ... is reachable from (2,7) ... in the way: Notice Board at (2,7)". My starting tile is blocked by the notice board, so no path can begin.

This is a hard stuck state. But let me try one more idea: maybe the notice board can be interacted with to read it, and reading it might be done by pressing KeyE while standing on it — but the game checks the facing tile. 

Let me try pressing KeyE while facing each of the 4 directions AND check if maybe the notice board is actually at an adjacent tile that I misread. Let me look very carefully with world_map at radius 2.
